standard.label: Standard
standard.short_desc: Spacious and stylish Standard rooms have everything you need for a comfortable stay.
standard.single_desc:
Spacious and stylish Standard rooms have everything needed for a comfortable stay. A harmonious blend of modern design with a thoughtfully crafted interior — perfect for both business and leisure travellers. All rooms feature a comfortable bed, workspace and cosy bathroom.

The hotel also has a specially equipped room for guests with limited mobility.
standard.double_desc: Spacious and stylish Standard rooms have everything needed for a comfortable stay. A harmonious blend of modern design with a thoughtfully crafted interior makes this room an ideal choice for both business travellers and tourists. All rooms feature a comfortable bed, workspace and cosy bathroom.
standard.twin_desc: Spacious and stylish Standard rooms have everything needed for a comfortable stay. The room features two separate beds, making it an ideal choice for two guests. Modern design and a thoughtful interior ensure a comfortable rest.

deluxe.label: Deluxe
deluxe.short_desc: Spacious Deluxe rooms with panoramic city views and exquisite interiors for true comfort enthusiasts.
deluxe.single_desc: An elegant Deluxe room with a refined interior and all amenities for a comfortable stay. Spacious room with one large bed, workspace and premium bathroom.
deluxe.double_desc: A luxurious Deluxe room with a king-size bed and panoramic city views. Exquisite décor, soft lighting and premium materials create an incomparable atmosphere of comfort.
deluxe.twin_desc: A spacious Deluxe room with two separate beds. The ideal choice for business partners or friends. Premium interior and all Deluxe amenities.
deluxe.premium_desc: The pinnacle of the Deluxe category — a Premium room with an expanded layout, designer furniture and exclusive finishing materials. A bathroom with jacuzzi and panoramic views make this room truly special.

suite.label: Suite
suite.short_desc: Exclusive Suite apartments — the embodiment of luxury and impeccable service for the most discerning guests.
suite.executive_desc: The Executive Suite with a separate living room, bedroom and study. Impeccable service, designer interior and all amenities for the most discerning guests. Bathroom with jacuzzi and panoramic city views.
suite.presidential_desc: The Presidential Suite — the highest category at Hotel Senator. Spacious apartments with two bedrooms, a living room, terrace and personal butler. Exclusive interior and boundless comfort for the most special guests.
